quest.title: The Workshop Owner With a Sweet Tooth
quest.description: Jahoda informs you that the booth reserved for Aino has been sitting empty for too long. You'd better get her here lickety-split.
quest.rewards_formatted: Mora x10000, Adventurer's Experience x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3

chapter.num: Where Waves Meet the Reef: Part I
chapter.title: A Commission From the Curatorium of Secrets

talks.objective: Go to the Clink-Clank Krumkake Craftshop

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Hm...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, you two!

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, hello.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're helping out Nefer with some expo stuff, and we heard the Krumkake Craftshop is taking part.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Correct. Aino is just doing a final round of debugging on her "Thwack 'n Smack Defense Bots."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, is that her submission for the expo?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Yes. Moles and other small creatures often steal from the Craftshop, so Aino designed a defense bot based off of them to protect this place.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Upon further testing, these bots turned out to be highly effective, so she decided to perform some upgrades and bring them to the expo.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, so Aino is actually gonna trade one of her bots?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Not exactly. With the exception of a few special orders, Aino rarely sells her finished products. What she's trading at the expo is the blueprint, not the finished product.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ohhh... So, are you guys ready to head over, then?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Jahoda asked us to speed things along a bit. She's saving a super good spot for you, and she's worried people are gonna start asking questions.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: I told her I need to finish debugging first! There's no point in rushing or I'll have nothing to trade!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, Paimon's never seen Aino this serious before.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: The Craftshop is experiencing a severe shortage of funds. Aino is hoping the expo will improve our financial situation, so she's being extra thorough.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Where'd all the money go? Some kind of expensive research?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Negative. It's our dessert funds that are lacking. We have had at least 47 cases where excess dessert purchases have led to a shortage of research funds.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: As such, I decided to split up our research and dessert budgets. Aino is forbidden from dipping into one to transfer to the other.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: And not too long ago, she cleaned out the entire dessert budget for this month.

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: Alright, done! Thwack 'n Whack Defense Bots, do me proud!

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: Looks like we can head over now.

talks.objective: Take Aino and Ineffa to the event venue

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You lead Aino and Ineffa to the venue.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Hm... This looks like a good spot for the demo platform.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This new bot looks pretty interesting, Aino.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Hehehe! Swing by and try it out whenever you want! It'll blow your mind, I just know it!

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Thanks for the help.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No problem! Oh, and for registration, is it just gonna be you two?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Hmm... I will be participating, but there is no need to register Aino. She doesn't like to be around a lot of people. Once the expo starts, she'll head straight back to the Craftshop.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Good point...
